The orthorhombic La2Mg28Ti2 phase (reduced formula LaMg14Ti) crystallizes in space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements and 14-neighbor environments, while La and Ti each have 20 geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Mg 12-vertex and 14-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between La 20-vertex and Mg 14-vertex polyhedra.
